scope: One sine or cosine of an affine argument, constant amplitude and a nonzero constant inner derivative. Exact entry or a complete authored five-choice bank.

easy.workload: One reciprocal derivative and a basic trig integral. Indefinite integer shifts and signed integer/simple reciprocal slopes; definite quarter/half-turn endpoint values 0,+1,-1.

moderate.workload: Shifted special-angle bounds, pi-scaled derivatives, or rational derivative factors with nonzero endpoint work. Complexity is tied to work, not an original template label.

hard.origin: Authored composition of already established skills; no imported hard question is claimed.
hard.workload: Fractional amplitude and signed nonunit rational slope, angular shift, both transformed endpoint values nonzero with unlike sqrt(2)/2 and sqrt(3)/2 magnitudes; independent exact entry.
hard.justification: Requires coordinating factor/sign, two bound substitutions, two exact trig values, and signed radical subtraction without introducing a new integration method.

sampling: Shuffle structural cases first, sample compatible numbers second, alternate each family response shape on recurrence, shuffle delivered records, deduplicate mathematical tasks across response formats. Explicit finite count limit 200.
display: Preserve the selected trig function and affine argument. Show derivative, reciprocal factor, both bound substitutions, integration sign, both exact endpoint values, and final simplified key.
bank_policy: Complete authored rule-error bank supported by observed source errors; collision rejection. Zero-outcome banks generalize q-13644 rather than scaling every wrong value to zero.
exclusions: hard labels applied to routine easy cases
